annotations.title: Calculate IMT and stamp duty on a home purchase

description: What buying a home in Portugal costs on top of the price: IMT (property transfer tax), Imposto do Selo (stamp duty) and the published price of the property registration. Official 2026 tables, including the reduced IMT table and the stamp duty deduction for buyers aged 35 or under, and the flat rate for a buyer who is not tax resident in Portugal (`non_resident`), with what can be annulled later on request, and the 10 % rate for a company from a listed tax regime (`tax_haven_company`). Both taxes are charged on the higher of the contract price and the VPT: pass `vpt` when it is known. Returns amounts in cents and formatted in euros, with the source of the tables.

buyer_is_young.description: The buyer is 35 or under on the date of the deed, is buying their first own permanent home, is not an IRS dependant and has owned no residential property in the previous three years. Applies the reduced IMT table and the stamp duty deduction (art. 7.º-A Código do Imposto do Selo; not applied above the second band of the young buyers' table). Only applies when primary_home is true. Default: false

non_resident.description: The buyer is not and has never been tax resident in Portugal. IMT is then a flat rate with no exemption or reduction — no zero band, no young buyers' table, no stamp duty deduction (CIMT art. 17.º n.º 10); the result says what the Tax Authority annuls on request if the buyer becomes tax resident or lets the home at a moderate rent. A buyer who has already been treated as tax resident pays by the tables: leave it false. Default: false

primary_home.description: The buyer's own permanent home (habitação própria e permanente). Default: true

tax_haven_company.description: The buyer is a company or other entity with its tax domicile in a country, territory or region on the Portuguese list of more favourable tax regimes, or controlled directly or indirectly by such an entity. IMT is then 10 % with no exemption or reduction (CIMT art. 17.º n.º 4), whether or not it is resident, and it overrides non_resident. Never true for an individual (n.º 7). Default: false

territory.description: Mainland Portugal (continente) or the Azores and Madeira (regioes_autonomas). Default: continente

value.description: Purchase price as written in the contract, in euros, e.g. 250000 or 250000.50

vpt.description: Optional. The VPT (valor patrimonial tributário) from the caderneta predial, in euros. IMT and stamp duty are charged on the higher of the price and the VPT (CIMT art. 12.º n.º 1), so pass it when it is known
